summary: Heavy-unit civ that ages up through Commanderies. Templar players pick 1 TC aggression against fast-Castle civs or 2 TC against Rus, reach Castle around 12 and build Fortresses.
openings: 1 TC aggression against fast-Castle civs: Hospitaller at 2:20, double pilgrims, range and barracks, cheap rams.

spikes.label: Early aggression
spikes.detail: A Hospitaller Knight at 2:20 and cheap rams push against greedy openings.
spikes.answer: Wall up and keep spearmen ready if you're fast-castling.

spikes.label: Castle around 12
spikes.detail: The age-up takes about 45 seconds. Fortresses follow, with the Castile or Genoa Commanderies, and Poland late.
spikes.answer: Bring siege for Fortresses; avoid fighting inside their range.

scout: A Hospitaller around 2:20 means 1 TC aggression
Which Commanderie they choose each age

pairings.why: Heavy cavalry with anti-armor ranged support.

winConditions.detail: Pilgrims make gold from Sacred Sites.

howToBeat: Delhi is favored after holding a Templar spear rush.
Jeanne d'Arc players harass the pilgrims.
